pretexts: unsolicited investment opportunities promising higher-than-normal returns
fraudster claims they can return funds lost in previous investment fraud
fraudster develops romantic relationship then claims to be successful cryptocurrency investor
fake fixed income opportunities spoofing legitimate company names
promotion of incredible deal on low-priced stock
fake Initial Coin Offerings with official looking documentation
business or franchise opportunities including ATM machines and point of sale machines
high-pressure sales of gems as sound financial investment
gifting circle requiring recruitment of other investors
emerging_tactics: search engine optimization to target victims
remote access requests to victim's computer or device
allowing small withdrawals to persuade larger investments

kill_chain_signals.contact: fraudsters contact previous investment fraud victims by telephone, email, social media or victims find them through search engine optimization; victims contacted on dating apps or social media
kill_chain_signals.pretext: fraudsters claim they can return funds lost in previous investment fraud; fraudster develops relationship and claims to be successful cryptocurrency investor who can help victim get rich
kill_chain_signals.payment: fraudsters tell victims there is a fee for their services; victims instructed to purchase cryptocurrency from legitimate exchange and transfer it to crypto address controlled by fraudster; requests for wire transfer to offshore bank account
kill_chain_signals.movement: victims transfer funds or cryptocurrency into fake trading account; cryptocurrency transferred to address controlled by fraudster
kill_chain_signals.cashout: victims realize fraud when they try to withdraw their funds and are unable to; fraudster sells shares at peak in pump and dump leaving investors with worthless stocks

red_flags: Unsolicited investment opportunities (even from friends and family)
key_quote: Fraudsters will do everything it takes to make you think the investment is legitimate and lucrative.
title: Investment
